kurzbeschreibung: Das Tirol Panorama on the Bergisel in Innsbruck presents the monumental giant panoramic painting of the Tyrolean fight for freedom of 1809 and the historic Kaiserjägermuseum.
beschreibung:
Monumental 360-Degree Cyclorama of the Battles of Bergisel

The museum Das Tirol Panorama on the historic Bergisel in Innsbruck houses a fascinating artwork of European distinction: the roughly 1,000-square-metre giant cyclorama depicting the dramatic events of the Tyrolean rebellion of 1809.

Fascinating Regional History and the Kaiserjägermuseum

Underground, the modern exhibition building connects directly to the historic Kaiserjägermuseum. Imaginatively staged exhibits explore religion, nature, politics, and the cultural history of the Alpine region in compelling depth.
